usage.outputShape: body.records.<TYPE>[] (each {name,ttl,data}); convenience arrays at body.flat.{a,aaaa,mx,ns,txt,cname,caa}; body.domain, body.types_queried[], body.total_records, body.source
quirks: Service ignores any 'type' param and always queries all record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CAA) at once — read the type you want from body.records or body.flat.
No txHash returned by payment layer (confirmed=false), but call settled and returned 200.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.agentutility.ai/dns-lookup with a JSON body containing {"domain":"<domain>"} and pay the $0.02 USDC x402 charge (Base, eip155:8453). The response is synchronous JSON. Read records by type at body.records (e.g. body.records.A[].data for IPv4) or use the flattened lists at body.flat (body.flat.a, body.flat.mx, body.flat.ns, etc.). It always returns all record types regardless of any 'type' field you send.
